KCM vs VEXI: Which Is Better for Realtors in 2026?
KCM and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Compare KCM vs VEXI side-by-side. See pricing, features, and why 1,000+ realtors choose VEXI for done-for-you social media.

KCM’s research team turns housing market data into blog posts, graphics and videos with your brand on them [1]. VEXI makes posts, videos, designs and captions from what you ask for. The two overlap on social media and work in different ways.

KCM (Keeping Current Matters) has helped agents explain the housing market for nearly two decades [1]. Its research team makes new blog posts, social graphics and videos every week, and you add your photo, logo and colors in one click [1]. Smart Campaigns build your weekly posting plan, and KCM auto-posts to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and more [2]. RealTalk, its video teleprompter with ready-written scripts, is included in both plans [2]. Plans are $59.95 or $99.95 a month billed monthly, after a 14-day free trial [2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on social media and work in different ways. Here is what each one does.

Every KCM piece is personalized with your photo, name, brand colors and contact info [2]. Its FAQ says some of the shareable content is the same for all members, and that how each member uses it is what sets them apart [3].
VEXI makes graphics in your brand.
Much of KCM’s core content covers the national housing market [3]. KCM Elite adds local market data for your zip code, local video scripts and the Graphic Builder for local market charts [2].

KCM auto-posts to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and more, on a weekly posting plan its Smart Campaigns build for you [2].

KCM also includes an email and newsletter builder, buyer and seller guides with your branding, and live monthly market updates [2]. KCM Elite adds Playbooks, with scripts and timed outreach for following up with buyers and sellers [2].

KCM’s Social Edge is $59.95 a month and KCM Elite $99.95 a month billed monthly, or $49.95 and $83.29 a month billed annually, each after a 14-day free trial [2]. There is no contract, and both plans include a 30-day money-back guarantee [2].
